question: For every stadium, show how many concerts it hosted in 2014, including stadiums with zero.
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) FROM stadium AS s LEFT JOIN concert AS c ON CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR) = c.Stadium_ID AND c.Year = '2014' GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
candidate_sql:
SELECT
    s.Stadium_ID,
    s.Name,
    COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium AS s
LEFT JOIN concert AS c
    ON TRY_CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS BIGINT) = s.Stadium_ID
    AND c.Year = '2014'
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
ORDER BY s.Stadium_ID;
evaluation_evidence: Candidate results differ from the reference results.
